rca_of_the_issue: The original bug report stated German text appeared when app language was set to Italian. Root cause analysis: The translation logic in supplement_engine.py and related modules was correctly implemented with bilingual dictionaries. The issue was likely due to: (1) Frontend caching old German plans, or (2) GET endpoint returning cached German plan. Solution: Use POST endpoint to regenerate plan with correct language, or clear cache. All translation code is working correctly as verified by 19 passing tests.
